strategies.name: Cash / no-trade benchmark
strategies.entry_rules: Always NO TRADE. Hold virtual cash; no assumed interest.
strategies.limitations: No alpha claim; comparable observed session coverage still required.
strategies.data_requirements: Authorized sourced OHLCV; complete closed bars; observation timestamps; verified regular NSE calendar; instrument identity and adjustment basis.
strategies.validation: Not validated on NSE. No held-out accuracy or profit claimed.

strategies.name: 15-minute opening range + VWAP
strategies.category: Opening range breakout and price action
strategies.entry_rules: LONG when previous close ≤ opening high < current close AND close > session VWAP. SHORT uses the reversed low breakout. Evaluate only after the complete 09:15–09:30 range.
strategies.exit_rules: Next-bar limit at signal close, validity 15 minutes; stop 1 ATR, target 2 ATR; timeout 90 minutes; simulator closes by 15:15 IST. Stop first on ambiguous OHLC bars.
strategies.formula: OR_high = max(H in first 15m); OR_low = min(L in first 15m). ATR14 = mean of 14 true ranges.
strategies.limitations: Our proposed NSE baseline; different range, ATR and exits from the source. Not a reproduced published strategy.
strategies.data_requirements: Authorized sourced OHLCV; complete closed bars; observation timestamps; verified regular NSE calendar; instrument identity and adjustment basis.
strategies.validation: Not validated on NSE. No held-out accuracy or profit claimed.

strategies.name: EMA9 / session VWAP crossing
strategies.entry_rules: LONG if prior EMA9 ≤ prior VWAP and current EMA9 > current VWAP; SHORT is the reverse. Require complete session volume and closed bars.
strategies.exit_rules: Next-bar limit at signal close, validity 15 minutes; stop 1 ATR, target 2 ATR; timeout 90 minutes; simulator closes by 15:15 IST. Stop first on ambiguous OHLC bars.
strategies.formula: EMA_t = (2/10) C_t + (8/10) EMA_previous; SMA(9) seed. VWAP = Σ[(H+L+C)/3 × V] / ΣV.
strategies.limitations: Negative-control candidate. Source failed net-edge confirmation; our ATR/limit execution is a new adaptation.
strategies.data_requirements: Authorized sourced OHLCV; complete closed bars; observation timestamps; verified regular NSE calendar; instrument identity and adjustment basis.
strategies.validation: Not validated on NSE. No held-out accuracy or profit claimed.

strategies.name: Residual z-score mean reversion
strategies.entry_rules: Proposed: fit residual on training prefix, LONG below −2, SHORT above +2; no entries during detected trend regime.
strategies.exit_rules: Design only: exit near zero, hard ATR stop, time limit and end-of-session cutoff.
strategies.formula: z_t = (x_t − μ_training) / σ_training; zero or missing σ blocks.
strategies.limitations: Thresholds require frozen specification and validation before code/activation.
strategies.data_requirements: Authorized sourced OHLCV; complete closed bars; observation timestamps; verified regular NSE calendar; instrument identity and adjustment basis.
strategies.validation: Not validated on NSE. No held-out accuracy or profit claimed.

strategies.name: Cointegrated residual / OU
strategies.entry_rules: Design only: cointegration and residual-stationarity gate before two-leg z-score entry.
strategies.exit_rules: Synchronized two-leg exits; reject missing hedge liquidity.
strategies.formula: x_(t+Δ)=a+b x_t+ε; κ=−ln(b)/Δ, μ=a/(1−b), half-life=ln(2)/κ for 0<b<1.
strategies.limitations: Correlation alone is insufficient; two-leg costs, changing hedge ratios and shortability are unresolved.
strategies.data_requirements: Authorized sourced OHLCV; complete closed bars; observation timestamps; verified regular NSE calendar; instrument identity and adjustment basis.
strategies.validation: Not validated on NSE. No held-out accuracy or profit claimed.

strategies.name: Compression as a volatility feature
strategies.entry_rules: Design only: compare next-window absolute returns against simple volatility-clustering baseline.
strategies.formula: BB = SMA ± k σ; KC = EMA ± m ATR; squeeze when BB lies inside KC.
strategies.limitations: Compression is not evidence of imminent directional profit; corrected negative findings retained.
strategies.data_requirements: Authorized sourced OHLCV; complete closed bars; observation timestamps; verified regular NSE calendar; instrument identity and adjustment basis.
strategies.validation: Not validated on NSE. No held-out accuracy or profit claimed.

strategies.name: Lagged volatility versus HMM regimes
strategies.entry_rules: Design only: compare lagged realized-volatility bins with filtered HMM state probabilities.
strategies.exit_rules: Regime filter only; cannot generate a standalone trade.
strategies.limitations: Never use full-sample smoothed states or refit on test data.
strategies.data_requirements: Authorized sourced OHLCV; complete closed bars; observation timestamps; verified regular NSE calendar; instrument identity and adjustment basis.
strategies.validation: Not validated on NSE. No held-out accuracy or profit claimed.

strategies.name: Calibrated baseline / tree ensemble
strategies.entry_rules: Design only: logistic baseline before random forest or boosting; select only after purged chronological evaluation.
strategies.exit_rules: Net expected value must exceed costs and uncertainty; abstain otherwise.
strategies.formula: p = sigmoid(β0+βᵀx); Brier = mean((p−y)²); EV = pW−(1−p)L−cost.
strategies.limitations: No model trained, no accuracy/forecast available. LLM text cannot authorize simulator entries.
strategies.data_requirements: Authorized sourced OHLCV; complete closed bars; observation timestamps; verified regular NSE calendar; instrument identity and adjustment basis.
